critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/server.py:936-1019 PnL endpoint: cleanly separates accrual (period_year/period_month with amount_due) vs cash (paid_date with amount_paid). Late-fee assessment is gated by due_by=day 10 + waiver flag + payment date — correct per spec.
/app/backend/server.py:945-951 BUDGET_TO_EXPENSE mapping aligns budget category names with expense category names so variance lines net out properly (e.g., 'Snow Plowing' -> 'Snow Removal').

/app/backend/server.py:997 Budget query uses ed.year (period-end year). Note: a custom range that spans two years (e.g., 2024-11-01..2025-02-28) will only pull budget items for 2025; acceptable for now since the UI year/period selectors avoid cross-year ranges, but worth documenting.

/app/frontend/src/pages/PnL.jsx is well factored (~170 lines), uses useMemo for range and useEffect deps on (start,end,basis). All required data-testid hooks present including per-category pnl-exp-<category>. Print uses window.print() directly — meets spec.
/app/frontend/src/pages/Budget.jsx adds budget-print-btn via window.print(). print-area wrapper is on the totals card and items table — sidebar is .no-print/aside hidden via @media print as expected.

/app/frontend/src/components/layout/AppShell.jsx nav links list now includes /pnl with testid nav-pnl and LineChart icon. Mobile nav exposes m-nav-pnl automatically via template literal — no separate change needed.
